neptune_job_monitor.name: neptune-bulk-load-job-monitor
neptune_job_monitor.description: Periodically check Neptune bulk loading job status

neptune_bulk_load_jobs.name: neptune-bulk-load-jobs
neptune_bulk_load_jobs.description: Notifications for Neptune bulk loading job events

neptune-bulk-loader-async.description: Initiates Neptune bulk loading jobs asynchronously

neptune-bulk-loader-monitor.description: Monitors Neptune bulk loading job status

neptune-bulk-loader-completion.description: Handles Neptune bulk loading job completion

deployment_commands.create_sns_topic: aws sns create-topic --name neptune-bulk-load-jobs --profile solve-global --region us-east-1
deployment_commands.create_eventbridge_rule: aws events put-rule --name neptune-bulk-load-job-monitor --schedule-expression 'rate(2 minutes)' --description 'Monitor Neptune bulk loading jobs' --profile solve-global --region us-east-1
deploy_lambda_functions: aws lambda create-function --function-name neptune-bulk-loader-async --runtime python3.9 --role arn:aws:iam::861276078413:role/nlp-integration-lambda-role --handler neptune_bulk_loader_async.lambda_handler --zip-file fileb://neptune-bulk-loader-async.zip --vpc-config SubnetIds=subnet-0c0be1dd59f70f70e,subnet-03d8bd6cf3491f38c,SecurityGroupIds=sg-0c043bcb40f656321 --timeout 60 --memory-size 256 --profile solve-global --region us-east-1

aws lambda create-function --function-name neptune-bulk-loader-monitor --runtime python3.9 --role arn:aws:iam::861276078413:role/nlp-integration-lambda-role --handler neptune_bulk_loader_monitor.lambda_handler --zip-file fileb://neptune-bulk-loader-monitor.zip --vpc-config SubnetIds=subnet-0c0be1dd59f70f70e,subnet-03d8bd6cf3491f38c,SecurityGroupIds=sg-0c043bcb40f656321 --timeout 60 --memory-size 256 --profile solve-global --region us-east-1

aws lambda create-function --function-name neptune-bulk-loader-completion --runtime python3.9 --role arn:aws:iam::861276078413:role/nlp-integration-lambda-role --handler neptune_bulk_loader_completion.lambda_handler --zip-file fileb://neptune-bulk-loader-completion.zip --vpc-config SubnetIds=subnet-0c0be1dd59f70f70e,subnet-03d8bd6cf3491f38c,SecurityGroupIds=sg-0c043bcb40f656321 --timeout 300 --memory-size 256 --profile solve-global --region us-east-1
